risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantitative disclosure on capitalization, liquidity, loan composition, charge-offs, and provisions, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and several qualitative assurances. Credit risk has worsened materially, with provisions and net charge-offs increasing significantly, including losses concentrated in commercial, commercial real estate, and construction exposures. Liquidity and regulatory capital are presented as mitigating strengths, although the excerpt is truncated and leaves some portfolio and economic-risk discussion incomplete.
